faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send the application via email for the Junior Research Assistant post at IIT BHU is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Assistant posts at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Research Assistant position in the latest recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Technology Banaras Hindu University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/BTech/ME/MTech in computer science or a related discipline with a first division throughout their academic career from high school onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Assistant post is 28 years as of 01 April 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant post at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Assistant position will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month, as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Assistant recruitment at IIT BHU. The application process is free.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Junior Research Assistant at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Assistant post involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply by sending their complete application, including bio-data and self-attested documents, via email to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation of 5 years is provided for SC/ST/physically handicapped/female candidates as per the government norms and the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Assistant position will be in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Banaras Hindu University (IIT BHU).
